mission: Parallel Jedi Council session — Corran Horn against GAG cooperation; Luke holds.
why_now: The GAG has requested Jedi cooperation on Coruscant-side operations.
opening_hook: Luke at the head of the chamber table with the GAG cooperation request on a datapad.
conflict: Corran's insistence that cooperating with GAG sets a precedent the Order cannot afford vs. Luke's calculation that refusal loses Order influence inside the internal-security apparatus.
turning_point: Luke commits the Order to case-by-case cooperation — neither full refusal nor full alliance.
closing_hook: Corran Horn leaving the chamber at Luke's back, unhappy but not resigning.
setting: Jedi Council chamber, Jedi Temple, Coruscant.
sensory_details: Chamber's formal hush; Corran's controlled frustration; Mara's watchful steadiness.
emotional_trajectory: Policy debate → compromise posture → Council fracture visible.
notes: The fracture is visible but not yet rupture.
